evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Obliteration of lateral meniscus, reflecting tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee, more severe at lateral femorotibial joint.
evidence.Lateral OA: more severe at lateral femorotibial joint with subchondral sclerosis and mild edema and tiny cystic change, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.PF OA: Grade 3 chondromalacia of patella and femoral trochlea
evidence.Effusion: Moderate joint effusion-synovitis of right knee
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral sclerosis and mild edema and tiny cystic change, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Fracture: Osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at lateral femorotibial joint with subchondral sclerosis and mild edema and tiny cystic change, reflecting osteoarthritis
